```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

This stores the key in your `.Renviron` file so every future R session finds it automatically. The key is stored on this machine only—on a new machine, install it again with `census_api_key("KEY", install = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)`. In other words, if you install the key in a Codespace, it disappears when the Codespace does. You will need to do it again when you start a new Codespace, at least until you learn how to create a dotfiles repo.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(median_age = "B01002_001", population = "B01003_001"),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca_wide <- age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate) |>
  arrange(desc(population))

age_ca_wide
```

```{r}
edu_state_summary <- edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarise(
    bachelors_plus = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    total = first(summary_est),
    percent_bachelors_plus = 100 * bachelors_plus / total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_bachelors_plus))

ggplot(edu_state_summary, aes(
  x = percent_bachelors_plus,
  y = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_plus)
)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#365C8D") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher (%)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2016-2020 American Community Survey 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Median household income (USD)",
                       labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "2020 Median Household Income by Texas County",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2016-2020 American Community Survey 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
